title: Schedules
subtitle: Run experiments and drift canaries on a timetable with a daily spend cap, and get a webhook when something regresses.
empty: No schedules yet. Add one below: pick an experiment file, a cron time and a daily cap.
noTicker: This server cannot run scheduled jobs right now (it runs offline). Schedules are saved and fire once the job runner is on.
hostedLimits: Scheduled experiments run on your runners. This organization uses {{count}} of {{max}} schedules; each fires at most every {{min}} minutes.
queued: Queued job {{id}}. Follow it in the jobs drawer.

add.title: Add a schedule
add.name: Name
add.hint: Example: 0 6 * * * runs every day at 06:00. Non-smoke experiments need a budget.total_usd and a daily cap at least that large.

alerts.title: Webhook alerts
alerts.description: Sent for every schedule. The URL is never stored here: store it as an org secret (Settings > Secrets) and pick its name.
alerts.noSecrets: No org secrets yet. Add the webhook URL in Settings > Secrets first.
